label: /paintings — Skip holds still while the reader pans the hall: the top-left corner reads its own inset (the gutter, the top and left safe areas), not the shared lane whose bottom inset moved it 14px on every bar transition
notes: Wil, 2026-09-22, after the ship: 'New problem, the skip button in the hall now moves its position when panning around the paintings hall, fix this, it should never happen do not change or break anything else.' Cause: Skip was positioned on --ui-inset, the lane every corner shares, which takes the deepest of the four safe areas; env(safe-area-inset-bottom) is 0 with Safari's bars expanded and 34px once they collapse (playbook §1), and a pan on the hall with any vertical drift is a page scroll (the canvas keeps touch-action: pan-y — the walk), which moves the bars — so Skip jumped 14px right and 14px down on every pan and back on the next. Reproduced here with the collapsed bars' inset emulated (CDP): 20/20 → 34/34, while the top-right menu, on round 23's --menu-inset, held. This round mirrors round 23 for the top-left corner: Skip reads --skip-inset (the gutter, the top inset and the left inset) on the stage; nothing else moves — the chip row's band is measured from Skip's box and holds with it, the bottom-centre column (Face forward, the dot rail) still rides the bottom lane (round 33's --ui-inset-b, = --ui-inset on iOS) by design, and wherever no safe area is set the new inset is the gutter exactly as the old one was. A new instrument, qa:skip (scripts/museum-skip.mjs), proves the corner holds through a look drag, a walk drag, a diagonal drag, a page scroll, the viewport at 753 and the bottom inset at 34, with the bars stood in and without, and at 1440/768. Numbered 36: while this round was measured, other sessions landed round 33 (the bottom lane under Android's gesture bar), round 34 (the map's ship, docs only), round 35 (the bottom lane's ship, docs only — main and release/2026-09-22 refreshed again) and round 23's device pass 17 (the chapter pages) on v2; this round was rebased onto their tip, e606214, which is its base, and every gate re-run there. Nothing else changes; no route may drift; main and release/2026-09-22 are refreshed at his sign-off, per the ship rule.
